aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: To avoid jail time for a campus crime, two reckless fraternity brothers masquerade as devout Christian camp counselors to complete their court-ordered community service.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: After pulling a stunt on campus that lands them in legal trouble, two party-loving fraternity brothers are forced to fulfill court-ordered community service. Desperate to avoid a harsh sentence, they fake religious devotion and secure positions as counselors at a strict Christian youth camp. As they struggle to maintain their pious facade while dealing with innocent campers, strict directors, and unexpected moral dilemmas, they are forced to confront their own shallow lifestyles. Ultimately, their chaotic summer journey brings about unexpected personal growth and genuine reflection.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Facing severe legal consequences after committing a wild crime on their college campus, two self-absorbed fraternity brothers are handed a strict court-ordered community service mandate. Seeing an easy way out, the duo decides to fake a newfound faith and apply for positions as counselors at a devout Christian summer camp. Upon arrival, their out-of-place party habits immediately clash with the wholesome environment, rigid schedules, and conservative camp directors. As they attempt to dodge actual work and keep their secret hidden, they are assigned to lead a group of impressionable young campers who look up to them for spiritual guidance. Navigating absurd religious activities, awkward group devotionals, and constant threats of exposure, the duo finds themselves unexpectedly caring for the kids in their charge. Over time, the absurd charade forces them to reflect on their past selfishness, accountability, and true character. Through a series of comedic misadventures and heartwarming moments, the brothers begin to learn real lessons about maturity and empathy. When their past actions threaten to catch up with them, they must choose between running away or taking true responsibility for their lives.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: When two hedonistic college fraternity brothers get caught committing a major infraction on campus, a judge sentences them to mandatory community service. In a frantic bid to fulfill their sentence without doing hard labor, they bluff their way into hiring as counselors at a conservative Christian youth camp. Completely out of their element, the pair must learn to speak the language of faith, endure strict camp rules, and guide impressionable youth, all while trying to keep their criminal records and wild lifestyles a secret. What begins as a cynical scheme to dodge consequences turns into an unpredictable journey of unexpected friendships, absurd misunderstandings, and personal discovery.

themes.theme: Culture Clash / Fish Out of Water

story_structure.climax: Their deception reaches a boiling point during a major camp-wide event, where a series of chaotic missteps threatens to reveal their true identities to both the camp leadership and the court.
story_structure.conflict: To dodge harsher penalties, they lie their way into positions as counselors at a strict Christian summer camp, forcing two self-centered frat-stars into a conservative, highly regulated environment.
story_structure.resolution: Forced to confront the fallout of their actions, the pair must take accountability for their fraud and original crime, leading to unexpected personal growth and a newfound sense of responsibility.
story_structure.introduction: Two wild, party-focused college fraternity members commit a campus offense and are sentenced to complete court-ordered community service.
story_structure.risingAction: As they struggle to maintain their facade, the duo must navigate vigilant camp directors, rowdy campers, and wholesome activities, with their reckless habits constantly threatening to blow their cover.
